people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: Ten parts fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;
translations.bsb: Thus ten shares fell to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan beyond the Jordan,
translations.kjv: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
translations.asv: And there fell ten parts to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan;
